name: io.github.Grid-Decentralized-Compute/grid
title: Grid
description: Run batch jobs on a decentralized GPU market. Two hosts run every task; pay only when they agree.

environmentVariables.name: GRID_AGENT_PRIVATE_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Wallet key the agent spends from, 0x followed by 64 hex digits. Fund it with only what the agent may spend. Without it the server can only browse the market.

environmentVariables.name: GRID_AGENT_ALLOWANCE
environmentVariables.description: Address of a compute allowance contract. Every payment to the markets is then sent through it, within its daily cap.

environmentVariables.name: GRID_AGENT_MAX_SPEND
environmentVariables.description: Most ETH one transaction may carry.

environmentVariables.name: GRID_AGENT_MAX_TOTAL
environmentVariables.description: Most ETH all transactions together may carry in any 24 hours.

environmentVariables.name: GRID_AGENT_DIRECT
environmentVariables.description: Set to 1 to also register the direct rental tools: rent_machine, get_access, my_rentals, end_rental.

environmentVariables.name: GRID_CHAIN_ID
environmentVariables.description: 46630 is Robinhood Chain testnet, 4663 is Robinhood Chain, 31337 is a local chain.

environmentVariables.name: GRID_RPC_URL
environmentVariables.description: Another RPC endpoint for the chain.

environmentVariables.name: GRID_SITE_URL
environmentVariables.description: Website that serves the receipt pages linked from results.
